meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 datamol 处理分子:解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符与指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象,支持并行批量处理;返回的是原生 rdkit.Chem.Mol 对象。
howto.when: 当你做常规药物发现中的分子处理,例如 SMILES 解析、标准化、指纹计算等时会用它;原文写明:需要高级控制或自定义参数时改用 rdkit。

say.text: 把 "CC(=O)O" 解析成分子并标准化,再输出它的 SMILES

say.text: 对这 100 个分子批量算描述符,用全部 CPU 核心
say.note: 并行计算后返回描述符表

say.text: 给这个分子生成 50 个 3D 构象并做能量最小化
say.note: 返回含多个构象的分子对象

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude uses datamol for molecule work: parsing SMILES, standardizing structures, computing descriptors and fingerprints, clustering, and generating 3D conformers, with parallel batch processing. It returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you do standard drug-discovery molecule handling such as SMILES parsing, standardization, or fingerprints. The doc states: for advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

say_en.text: Parse "CC(=O)O" into a molecule, standardize it, then output its SMILES
Batch-compute descriptors for these 100 molecules using all CPU cores
Generate 50 3D conformers for this molecule and minimize energy
say_en.note: Returns a molecule with multiple conformers
